full_prompt_en: A classical oil portrait presents a young woman leaning her cheek into one hand and glancing thoughtfully toward the left. Her softly curled fair hair spills around a pale cloth wrapped over the crown of her head. The face is turned three-quarters toward the viewer, with large brown eyes, a small mouth, and a slight warmth in the cheeks. A white linen garment opens at the neck beneath an olive-green outer layer, whose folds fill the lower corners. Her forearm rises from the bottom edge to support her chin, making a gentle diagonal that leads attention back to the illuminated face. The background is a close dark brown and olive field, without architecture or objects; its loosely worked paint contrasts with the more carefully modeled skin. Light enters softly from the upper left, brightening the forehead, nose, cheek, and hand before fading through the fabric into shadow. The curls and wrapped cloth are described with fine, warm strokes and subtle changes in value, while the darker garment uses broader, thicker paint. The composition is tightly cropped, but it retains enough shoulders and arm to make the pose feel unforced. A faint canvas-like grain and restrained earth palette give the image an aged, tactile character. The whole frame holds a quiet moment of private attention through warm flesh tones, deep surrounding shadow, and patient brushwork.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅古典油画人像呈现一位年轻女子将脸颊倚在手上，若有所思地望向左侧。浅色卷发柔软地散开，围绕着裹在头顶的浅色布巾。面容以四分之三角度朝向观者，大而棕色的眼睛、小巧的嘴和微微发暖的双颊清晰可见。白色亚麻衣在颈口展开，外覆橄榄绿色衣物，其褶皱填满下方两角。她的前臂从画面底边升起，托住下巴，形成一道柔和斜线，把注意力带回受光的脸。背景是贴近人物的深棕与橄榄色区域，没有建筑或物件；较松动的颜料处理与精心塑造的肌肤形成对比。光从左上方柔和进入，照亮额头、鼻子、脸颊与手，再沿布料渐渐隐入阴影。卷发与头巾由细致的暖色笔触和微妙明度变化描写，较暗的衣物则使用更宽、更厚的颜料。构图裁切紧密，却保留足够的肩膀和手臂，让姿势显得自然。淡淡的画布颗粒感和克制的土地色盘赋予图像古旧、可触的性格。整幅画借助温暖肤色、周围深影和耐心的笔法，保留一瞬私密而安静的凝神。
style_prompt_en: The classical oil image uses warm earth pigments, olive shadow, cream highlights, and finely graduated skin tones over a faint canvas-like grain. Soft directional light lifts a compact central area from a close dark field, then falls gently away through fabric and hair. Small careful strokes model the most delicate transitions, while broader paint passages carry garments and background. The contours around the lit region remain legible but never hard; peripheral edges dissolve into brown-green shadow. A rising diagonal organizes the lower half and returns the eye to the brightest area. The tonal range is restrained, with luminous cream and peach held against deep umber rather than vivid saturation. Subtle impasto and visible brush movement lend the smooth passages physical warmth. The whole frame feels intimate, patient, and aged through quiet chiaroscuro and tactile surface.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅古典油画图像在淡淡画布颗粒上使用温暖的土地色颜料、橄榄色阴影、奶油色高光，以及细腻渐变的肌肤色调。柔和的定向光把紧凑的中央区域从贴近的深色背景中提亮，随后沿布料与发丝轻轻消退。细小而谨慎的笔触塑造最微妙的过渡，更宽阔的颜料层承载衣物与背景。受光区域的轮廓清楚，却绝不生硬；外围边缘融入棕绿色阴影。下半部一道向上的斜线组织形体，又把目光带回最亮处。明暗范围受到节制，发亮的奶油色与桃色置于深棕色前，而不是依靠鲜艳饱和度。轻微厚涂与可见的笔触运动，让平滑区域也有物理温度。整幅画通过安静的明暗法和可触表面，显得亲密、耐心而有岁月感。
theme_en: A young woman resting her chin on her hand
name: Jean-Baptiste Greuze
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
